current_bottleneck: 330a/330c remain the clean 5/11 frontier, but the 331 exact-likelihood and 332 conditional-source tests show that local one-step transition repairs are capped. The persistent failures are long-horizon path-law failures: level KS, regime-responsive width, active-cell mean reversion, and pathwise max-jump shape.
last_result_summary: Postmortem after 332a: learned source scaling dropped from 5/11 to 3/11 by narrowing and upward-biasing free-run paths. This closes 332 as a knob family and strengthens the diagnosis that the 30-day conditional path distribution must be trained as the primary object rather than implied from a teacher-forced one-step transition law.
next_step_recommendation: Open 333 as a clean paradigm shift: a standard conditional masked path diffusion/flow model over the whole future path, with observed history supplied as tokens and future logit levels generated jointly. This keeps the generative core vanilla and tests whether a DiT/CSDI-style inpainting objective can learn the full conditional path law without low-rank, retrieval, residual shells, bounded side paths, or evaluator losses.
current_best_note: 330a and 330c tie the 5/11 frontier with cleaner first-principles autoregressive sequence-density models, without retrieval, low-rank readouts, residual shells, or evaluator-specific losses.
